objective: Best canonical full-panel distributional accuracy of adaptive selection algorithm, regardless of compute cost/complexity; runtime secondary
score_direction: Minimize canonical mainQ; maximize percent-better versus fixed worse asset reference on exact matched coverage
legacy_policy: research_workflow_policy.json remains frozen historical admission evidence; superseded for current selector scope, horizon adaptation and conditional portfolio permission
algorithm_scope: One coherent procedure; choices/parameters can vary by each asset/portfolio history and requested horizon from training-only internal out-of-sample forecasts
methodology_scope: Any credible method including computationally expensive alternatives; no blanket MCMC exclusion. Previous failed ideas require new evidence or materially different mechanism before reconsideration.
validation: Outer test outcomes inaccessible to fitting/selection. Prefer target-horizon internal rolling validation; data-derived horizon adaptation permitted with support disclosure. No arbitrary accuracy-reducing caps or automatic previous-winner fallback.
forecast_level: Joint asset paths preferred; portfolio-level candidates allowed only if measured asset-level runtime is infeasible
stopping: Current actual goal stopping paragraph applies unchanged; no stopping for small wins, a few losses or reaching aspiration. Final full suite with both references and best algorithm must finish and be verified.
catalogue: Count unique completed full-panel methods once; retain losing methods and all reproducibility/results. Private large archives plus public repository-linked recovery receipts; fresh download/full hash recovery before any retirement.
